# Feature Ticket

## Goal
What user/product outcome will this deliver?

## Context and source
Link requirement, API docs, issue, or ADR.

## Scope
- In scope:
- Out of scope:

## Dependencies
List required tickets and verified exchange behavior.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Behavior observable and testable.
- [ ] Error/edge cases specified.
- [ ] Safety invariants preserved.
- [ ] Docs updated in same change.

## Tests
Unit / contract / integration / replay / UI / failure tests, as relevant.

## Security/risk impact
Credentials, network, orders, positions, risk limits, controls or logs touched?

## Evidence for completion
Commands/test output, redacted screenshots, fixtures, or sanitized Testnet evidence.

## Rollback/recovery
How will this change be disabled or reversed safely?
